I published [this](https://artlu.xyz/posts/the-new-one-page-investment-memo/) on 12/18/2025, a day after I sold 70% of Strategy stock to buy Strategy fixed income securities.

Even with today's massive one-day +26% bounce, $MSTR is -18% since mid December on ~90% realized vol.

$STRC is actually up, including cash flow, on 20% realized vol. 

$STRD is -7% on 40% vol.

If bitcoin gets hit over the weekend, I think that will present a buying opportunity for $MSTR (sell fixed income, buy equity) as the risk-reward appears to have flipped.

But also, I think people are sleeping on crypto-native *securities* paying 10%+ sustainable yield.
